subject: Contract review: HelioBank redlines & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Diaz <marta.diaz@heliobank.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:00:00Z
Subject: Contract review: HelioBank redlines & procurement checklist

Hi Marta —

We were in the meeting room but it looks like HelioBank couldn’t make the contract walkthrough that was on the calendar for 9am PT. No worries — we know these things happen. When you get a second, can you confirm:

- Whether the attached redline bundle (v2) is the latest from your legal team
- If procurement wants to handle the SOW economics and the legal team the contract language, or if you prefer a combined walkthrough

We have availability tomorrow (Thu) 10:00–11:30 PT for a 45–60 minute call, or Friday 9:00–10:00 PT for a shorter sync. If neither works, please propose two 30–45 minute windows next week and we’ll prioritize.

We’d also like to surface a short procurement checklist in the call (attached) so we can close open commercial items quickly. Connor will lead the walkthrough from our side; Lauren will join for contract language questions.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so we can lock a time.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Marta Diaz <marta.diaz@heliobank.com>

Date: 2026-11-25T11:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Contract review: HelioBank redlines & procurement checklist

Hi Neha —

So sorry for missing the slot — we got pulled into an emergency board call that ran over. Thank you for the follow-up.

Quick answers: the attached HelioBank_SOW_redlines_v2.docx is the latest from Legal. Procurement would prefer to run the commercial items first (fees, billing cadence, termination language) and then hand off to Legal to walk through contractual redlines.

I can make Friday 9:00–9:30 PT for an initial procurement touch (short window) and then schedule a deeper legal redline walkthrough next week. If your team needs a longer Friday slot, I can try to free up 9:30–10:30 but it’s tight.

Attached: HelioBank_SOW_redlines_v2.docx (redline version, 18 pages)

Apologies again — Marta

Thanks Marta — appreciate the quick reply and the file.

Friday 9:00–9:30 PT works for a procurement-first agenda. To make the most of 30 minutes we’ll:
- Walk through pricing and billing cadence (10 mins)
- Confirm open commercial items and any requested credits/edu pricing (10 mins)
- Agree on owners and next steps for the redline walkthrough (10 mins)

Rishi, can you be on standby for any quick contract language clarifications? If we need >30 mins we’ll book a follow-up the same day.

Marta — I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a Teams link for Friday.

Quick internal note:

I agree with a split-track approach — procurement first, then legal. For the legal walkthrough next week, please ask Marta to flag any "must-have" redlines in the doc (comment or highlight) so we can prep targeted responses. I’ll prioritize language around data retention, audit logs, and SLA credits.

Proposal: Friday 9:00–9:30 PT for procurement (short), then Tue 11/30 10:00–11:00 PT for legal redline walkthrough. If Marta can’t do Tue, we’ll offer Wed 11/30 14:00–15:00 PT as alternative.
